overview_description.description: InVOID has one of the most robust systems to read and validate KYC documents in the Indian market. Our AI driven platform is device agnostic, vernacular, flexible and is extremely easy to integrate. We have a market leading National ID card OCR which works on all types and formats of National ID cards. Our core focus is to provide a winning customer experience for the everyday Indian user without compromising on KYC & Security
